After an unusual three-week wait, Apple today finally released iOS 27 beta 5, giving a number of apps including Siri and Safari a brand new set of icons.

Apple refreshes app icons in iOS 27 beta 5

iOS 27 is drawing closer to its public release, which is expected next month.

Today's beta 5 includes a number of user-facing changes as it prepares for the official launch.

Among them, several stock apps have been given new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of the new icons in the image above. Other apps have also received minor updates.

Since the first beta, iOS 27 has been gradually introducing icon design changes, with Apple continuing to refine last year's Liquid Glass aesthetic.

Apps such as Maps, Photos and Wallet have adopted new icons since iOS 27 testing began. However, today's beta 5 revisions show that Apple has still not finished tweaking the iOS 27 icons.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
